infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: DROPly uses the local Wi-Fi network to discover nearby devices and transfer files directly over TLS 1.3 without cloud servers.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: DROPly requires camera access to scan one-time QR pairing codes from nearby devices.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: DROPly needs photo library access so you can select photos and videos to share with nearby peers.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: DROPly saves received photos and videos to your library upon your approval.
